text: A gold coin vanished. Four suspects. One of them is lying.
New York. December twenty-first. Eight p.m. The coin disappears during a museum gala.
Suspect one, the guard: I was doing my rounds with my flashlight.
Suspect two, the cleaner: I was mopping the hall. The floor was still wet when the alarm rang.
Suspect three, the photographer: I was on the rooftop, shooting the sunset.
Suspect four, the chef: I was in the kitchen. My ice cream was melting.
